_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the variant key, Ensembl gene ID and eQTL Catalogue dataset identifier.

biological_context.description: Tissue or cell-type label of the QTL dataset.

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the tissue or cell type the QTL was measured in, as a handle into ontology_terms.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for the process this edge represents, as a handle into ontology_terms: regulation of gene expression for eQTLs, regulation of RNA splicing for spliceQTLs.

study.description: Handle of the studies record this QTL comes from.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this record was read from.

molecular_trait_id.description: Identifier of the molecular trait used for QTL mapping: an Ensembl gene ID for gene-expression QTLs, or a Leafcutter intron cluster ID for splice QTLs.

gene_id.description: Ensembl gene ID of the molecular trait.

credible_set_id.description: SuSiE credible-set identifier for this signal within the dataset.

variant_chromosome_position_ref_alt.description: Variant identifier as chromosome, position, reference and alternate alleles, underscore-separated, on GRCh38.

credible_set_size.description: Number of variants in the SuSiE credible set.

posterior_inclusion_probability.description: Posterior inclusion probability that this variant is causal for the molecular trait, from SuSiE fine-mapping.

p_value.description: Nominal p-value of association between the variant and the molecular trait.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of the association p-value. Capped at 400 when the reported p-value is 0.

effect_size.description: Regression coefficient of the alternate allele on the molecular trait.

standard_error.description: Standard error of the effect size.

credible_set_min_r2.description: Smallest linkage-disequilibrium r2 between any two variants in the credible set.

intron_chr.description: Chromosome of the spliced intron, parsed from the Leafcutter molecular trait ID. Present only on spliceQTL edges.

intron_start.description: Start of the spliced intron, parsed from the Leafcutter molecular trait ID. Present only on spliceQTL edges.

intron_end.description: End of the spliced intron, parsed from the Leafcutter molecular trait ID. Present only on spliceQTL edges.
